title: Logan Paul offers Chuck Clark $100,000 for the tape
summary: James Fox tells of Logan Paul offers Chuck Clark $100,000 for the tape, about c. 2022 at Remote Arizona, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: he offered him 100 Grand but he wouldn't

plain: James Fox, a UFO investigator and filmmaker, says that around 2022 the internet celebrity Logan Paul offered a man named Chuck Clark, who lives in remote Arizona, $100,000 for a VHS videotape Clark owns. According to Fox, Clark refused to sell, which tells you how much the tape is said to matter to him.
